maddeler.e:
نشهاب (form XI)
# نَشْهَابُّ (našhābbu) /naʃ.haːb.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
# نَشْهَابَّ (našhābba) /naʃ.haːb.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
# نَشْهَابِّ (našhābbi) /naʃ.haːb.bi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
